thread:
Jordan: Heads-up — planning to flip speculative-decoding v2 + a small KV-prefetch tweak in the canary tomorrow 10:30 PT. Want sign-off on audience, guardrails, and rollback plan.
Maya: Quick q — does specdec v2 require flash-attn? any compatibility caveats?
Mike: Specdec v2 has a runtime check, it degrades to safe-path if flash-attn kernels missing, but behavior differs w/ kv-prefetch enabled. Memory bump ~4-6% on long-context requests.
Kevin: Proposed guardrails: canary 10% on dedicated pool, realtime metric watch, auto-disable if 5 errors/min OR 3% p99 latency regression vs baseline.
Elaine: Ops: we need a deploy window and a health-check job that hits warm endpoints (prefixes) to exercise KV cache paths. Can we add a short smoke script?
Jordan: Yes, smoke script exists — added below. Also adding the rollout command for ops.
Jordan: ```
# rollout (internal CLI)
rictl feature toggle set speculative-decoding-v2 on --audience=canary:10pct --expires=2h --owner=jordan --guardrails=errors>5m,latency_p99>3%
```
Maya: Can we scope canary to models with short sequence length to limit mem growth? e.g., model-tag:seq<=1024
Mike: Good call. We'll limit audience to tag:seq_lt_1024 and customer-tier:dev. That keeps prod risk lower.
Kevin: Add alert hooks: slack @eng-runtime and runbook link. If guardrail triggers, toggle off and pin traffic to specdec-v1 fallback.
Elaine: Ops notes: schedule window 10:30-12:30 PT, will standby for manual rollback. also setting maintenance page in case latency hits customer-facing routes.
deploy-bot: :rocket: Canary rollout initiated for feature speculative-decoding-v2 (audience: canary 10%). Link: https://deploys.internal/rollouts/2061123456
Jordan: Smoke script (run before flip):
```
#!/bin/bash
# hit warm endpoints to populate kv cache
for i in {1..50}; do curl -s "https://canary.internal/model/health?prefix=test-$i" >/dev/null; done
```
Maya: Quick CR ping: I left a comment on the specdec PR about a null-check in the kernel selector. @Mike can you address before we flip?
Mike: On it, will patch in the next 20m and bump canary tag.
Kevin: Ops checklist (short): [x] runbook link, [x] alert channels, [ ] baseline metrics snapshot, [ ] p95/p99 dashboards pinned
Elaine: I'll take baseline snapshot at 10:15 PT and post metrics.
Jordan: If all green at +30m, we consider ramp to 30% for 1h then evaluate. Fallback plan: toggle off, restart a small subset if necessary.
Maya: :thumbsup:
Mike: PR patched and CI green. Ready for flip when ops ready.
ops-bot: Maintenance window scheduled 2026-06-14T10:30-12:30PT for toggle canary. Contact: @Elaine.
deploy-bot: Canary metrics: initial 15 minutes: errors=0, p99 latency +0.4% vs baseline, mem usage +5% on long requests. Link: https://metrics.internal/query?id=2061123456
Jordan: Thanks — I'll watch dashboards. If anything looks off, I'll hit the rollback toggle.
Kevin: I'll automate rollback if errors>5/min or p99>3% for 3 consecutive minutes.
Elaine: Standing by.
Jordan: Final: flipping at 10:30 PT. Ping here when you see any anomalies.
Maya: Noted.
Mike: Ready.
Elaine: Ready.
Jordan: :eyes:
